# UI final current runtime review: PASS

The current tooling source and recorded CLI output pass the developer UI review at `5fbebd9df3a60b6c29e09f7236c1b916fe4c4418` (4,750 Source files). This verdict supplies no live IDE or Android Studio visual fidelity credit. No blocking or nonblocking findings were found.

- The ten actual CLI cases match their expected results: two successful create/check commands and eight explicit errors for replacement, mismatch, changed identity/bytes, unsafe paths, duplicates, input budget and changed originals. Raw hashes, current-Source guards and preserved output paths agree.
- The actual JSON is 53,129 bytes with SHA-256 `1e55ecb3bbe9273483795d66a349a97043bb870e6cdcf191adc113b09bba7596`. Its two BUILD files, three modules, nineteen protocol facts and 67 verified original witness spans distinguish literal source evidence from runtime membership.
- Null compiled membership/runtime counts, unresolved applicability, false archive reverification/global census and zero new original behavior credit remain visible. BUILD syntax coverage does not suppress module-level configuration limits or the unsupported macro.
- Current shape/filter/reserved-name/empty-lint constraint paths preserve explicit unresolved reasons and avoid unsupported relationships. Documentation, help source, provenance and all sixteen original files retain the initially reviewed bytes and attribution.
- The frozen normal CLI executable matches the current-worktree `Fresh=false` compiler artifact and actual CLI summary. Inspected owner logs show 136 normal xtask tests passing, including all 22 supplementary membership tests, plus strict scoped repository Clippy and workspace formatting. No new execution was performed by this reviewer.
- Canonical ledger/manifest and existing census/declaration contracts remain identical to the task base. Every fixed-scope Source name, byte hash, type mode and the full stage index, clean status and HEAD match the retained current CLI snapshot.

An initial reviewer byte-check assertion followed a tracked repository symlink instead of using its recorded link payload. After inspecting the link, index mode and snapshot representation, the read-only check was corrected to compare link bytes and repeated successfully for all 4,750 entries. No product/test/evidence mutation occurred; the companion JSON retains this inspection correction.

The previous static reports are preserved. Lead full-app/current full workspace CI, final five-area completion and protected integration remain pending. The reviewer ran read-only inspections and wrote these external reports only. The source read hold is released.
